description:
READ-ONLY inventory of the SYSTEM dependencies Odoo needs at run time, taken on
    BOTH machines and compared. Covers the external programs Odoo shells out to
    (wkhtmltopdf, wkhtmltoimage, fc-list, pdftoppm, pdftotext, node, zip, unzip, pg_dump,
    and the optional gs/soffice/convert) with the count of installed FONTS as a separate
    fact, the font/library packages that carry no command of their own, the machine
    ARCHITECTURE, and the python libraries the addons on the source declare and import.

    Reports only what the TARGET lost relative to the SOURCE - a tool missing from both
    machines is named as such and is NOT a regression. Returns a pass/warn/fail finding
    list, a verdict, and a ready-to-run `plan` for `sysdeps_install`. Changes nothing.

    Pass `addons_paths` (absolute) if the client's own modules live outside the standard
    locations - `migrate_inspect` reports them under custom_addons.
name: sysdeps_inspect
